items.title: Authorize every file download and derivative
items.objective: Determine whether changing a file ID, storage key, filename, or transformation retrieves another user's private file.
prerequisites: An owner-approved file flow and documented safety limits
Small inert fixtures, disposable records, and controlled storage/viewers
steps: Create or select synthetic files owned by two designated accounts
Capture the normal upload, processing, storage, or retrieval flow
Change one filename, type, path, size, object, or parser condition with an inert fixture
Verify authoritative storage/response behavior and clean every test artifact

examples.note: Use only a small inert fixture. Target: synthetic files owned by two designated accounts.

items.vulnerable_behavior: one account retrieves the other account’s original, preview, thumbnail, or converted derivative

false_positives: public avatars and published files can intentionally be readable
